scientific_integrity: The classical matrix-tree theorem and ordinary ladder spanning-tree count are prior inputs. Exact finite computations corroborate, but do not replace, the infinite proof. Independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only open two-rail ladders; no exact even-dimensional Fourier-zero multiplicities and no inverse endpoint norms beyond ell^2; historical priority remains bounded by searched accessible sources.
title: Parity-complete Fourier invertibility and sharp spectral gap for ladder spanning trees
